content.text: Who Is Amy Madigan's Husband? All About Ed Harris, Their Daughter and More X 0 Amy Madigan’s Husband: All About Her 40-Year Love Story With Ed Harris Avery Thompson March 15, 2026, 6:33 pm Comments Arturo Holmes / Getty Images This excerpt appearscourtesy of our partner site Amy Madigan has been a powerhouse all awards season. The veteran actress has collected almost every single major award leading up to the Oscars for her incredible performance as the villainous Aunt Gladys in Weapons. Throughout awards season, Madigan has had her longtime love, Ed Harris, by her side through it all. Talk about a Hollywood power couple. Madigan’s run this awards season has been building up to the Academy Awards, and she’s the frontrunner to take home the Best Supporting Actress statue during the 2026 ceremony.
